name: Yuewang Tower
description: The Yuewang Tower is located on the top of Guishan Mountain in Mianyang City, Sichuan Province. It was built by Li Zhen, the eighth son of Emperor Taizong Li Shimin of the Tang Dynasty, when he was the governor of Mianzhou. It was built more than 1,350 years ago during the Xianqing period of Emperor Gaozong of the Tang Dynasty. It is one of the famous cultural buildings of the Tang Dynasty, along with the Yellow Crane Tower, Tengwang Pavilion and Yueyang Tower. Because of its grand scale, magnificence and ten feet high building, it ranked first among the four famous buildings at that time. The magnificent Yuewang Tower has attracted famous literati and poets for more than a thousand years, leaving more than 150 famous poems. It is also known as the "No. 1 Poetry Tower in the World".
